purpose: Resolve every W6 generic Profile output request at the Profile/PPR authority layer. An owner decision may admit a provenance-preserving customer field, admit only a narrower evidence view, or explicitly decline a generic semantic field. PVP does not create meaning.

fieldDecisions.construction: Summarize which governed source lanes and customer sections are present, plus freshness/provenance. Do not synthesize a universal personality statement.
Group existing signalCards by sourceClass/providerFamily and preserve domainId/facetId/value/provenance. No universal dimension set, no cross-instrument normalization, no master score.
A high, top, or ranked source score is not automatically a generic strength. A future Profile/PPR successor would need explicit interpretation rules before this field can exist.
Expose only already admitted SOURCE_TENSION and POTENTIAL_FRICTION_TARGET evidence with original provenance. Do not create cost scores, weakness labels, or strength-cost pairings.
No current Profile authority defines a general decision-style output. Isolated source facets may remain source-scoped but cannot be promoted.
Retain existing specific-person relationship evidence only. Do not derive an individual relationship-style label from it.
Retain O*NET RIASEC interest/exploration output as interest evidence. Do not relabel it as work style, ability, suitability, or job fit.
Source-scoped pressure/recovery/self-regulation facets may remain visible with source labels; no generic stress-pattern interpretation is authorized.
Any ENVIRONMENT_FIT self-report facet remains a self-report signal only. No objective or cross-source environment-fit conclusion is authorized.
Expose admitted Current Reality counts/states and cross-source evidence as context evidence. Do not infer a new context-dependent personality type or score.
Expose SOURCE_CONTRADICTION perspectives and Current Reality not-resonant evidence when present, keeping source/context provenance. Do not collapse disagreement into a universal truth verdict.
Collect only prompts already emitted by an admitted source lane, currently including career-interest Current Reality prompts. No generic question generation is authorized by this successor.

crossSourceProjectionDecision.purpose: Resolve the PFIG-005 label mismatch without letting PVP invent semantic equivalence.
crossSourceProjectionDecision.contextDependentRule: CONTEXT_DEPENDENT is not inferable from a group label alone. It requires explicit governed Current Reality/context evidence tied to the compared perspective; until W7 IR can prove that input, retain the native Profile group or UNKNOWN.
